blind.description: A stylized low wooden shop shelf and cabinet. The bottom tier features a double-door cupboard with small wooden knobs and dark corner hardware. Above are two open shelves stocked with goods: a yellow cheese wheel, a small red lidded jar, and folded green and striped fabrics on the lower shelf; a coil of rope, a wooden banded bucket, and folded striped blankets on the upper shelf. The top surface holds two tan cloth sacks, another red ceramic jar, and a dark lantern. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and stylized with clean hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: An elongated rectangular wooden top surface flanked by rectangular corner posts, topped with a row of items: two rounded tan sacks, a round red lidded jar, and a square-based dark lantern.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
